name: @meter-mcp/cli
stderr:
Usage: meter [options] [command]

Meter CLI for MCP service providers

Options:
  -V, --version                 output the version number
  --profile <name>              config profile
  --json                        machine-readable output
  --base-url <url>              override the profile's base URL
  --service-id <id>             override the profile's service ID
  --api-key <key>               override the profile's API key
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  login                         Save credentials for a Meter service
  logout                        Remove the profile
  whoami                        Show the authenticated service
  services                      Manage the service profile
  integration                   Manage the gateway integration
  prices                        Manage per-tool credit prices
  keys                          Manage service API keys
  customers                     Manage customer accounts
  balance <localId>             Show a customer's balance
  ledger [options] <localId>    Show a customer's ledger
  usage [options]               Show usage rollups
  events                        Inspect usage events
  webhooks                      Manage webhook endpoints
  listen [options]              Stream provider webhooks to your terminal or a
                                local URL
  call [options] <tool>         Call an MCP tool for testing (direct to --url,
                                or via the gateway)
  init [options] [name]         Scaffold an embedded-metering MCP server and
                                register its Meter service
  oauth-proxy [options] [name]  Scaffold a Cloudflare Workers OAuth proxy
                                fronting an existing Meter-backed MCP endpoint
  help [command]                display help for command
